title: Wilder Penfield and false memories

tellings.quote: named Dr. Wilder Penfield who was involved in early mind control stuff, you know, shows that this is true in mice.

plain: Work by a doctor named Wilder Penfield, who Michels says was "involved in early mind control stuff", is said to show in mice that false memories can be planted. Michels says this himself in a conversation with a guest, without naming a study. He brings it up as support for the idea that memories, including memories of strange encounters, can be created or altered.
